verdict.rationale: Direct probe confirms llms.txt is live at docs.runpod.io/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with a structured summary of Runpod's developer docs, and Runpod also publishes agent-oriented docs (MCP servers, agent-skills page) explicitly designed for pointing coding agents at Runpod. Missing for 10: no independent/community corroboration of agents actually consuming llms.txt in practice.
